name: Open Commons Day 2026
tagline: Talks, workshops, cake, conversations and a fundraiser for our shared space.
description: Pass by the Commons Hub for a day of workshops in all our rooms, coffee and cake, a kicker tournament, and a chance to visit the space and meet the community.
location: Commons Hub Brussels, Rue de la Madeleine 51, 1000 Brussels

sessions.title: Commons Game: Learning the Principles of Elinor Ostrom
Digital Independence Day
sessions.description: Explore one tool, service or app that makes you more independent of Big Tech companies.

sessions.title: Commons Hub: What Happened, What’s Next?
sessions.description: The founders of Commons Hub, Leen and Xavier, sit down with members of the community to talk openly about what happened, how we got here, and why this place is so close to our hearts. We’ll share the story of the past few years, including the recent hack, and talk about the fundraising effort to keep the Hub going. This is a conversation rather than a presentation: a space to ask questions, share experiences, and explore how we can support the Hub and its future.

sessions.title: Projective Dreamwork Circle
sessions.description: Become a conscious actor in your personal revolution and more by working with the wisdom of your dreams from sleep.

sessions.title: Running and Building AI Models for Raspberry Pi AI HAT
Strategic LinkedIn Networking
sessions.description: Build real relationships and expand your professional reach.

sessions.title: Cosmo-Localism: Global Knowledge, Local Production
sessions.description: Michel Bauwens introduces his cosmo-localism ideas, followed by a Q&A. Cosmo-localism combines resilient, regenerative local production with globally shared knowledge, open designs and trans-local cooperation. The basic principle is that what is materially heavy should be produced locally, while knowledge, designs and other “light” resources can be shared globally.

sessions.title: Your Job Stopped? Your Work Starts @ Commons Hub
sessions.description: Explore how Commons Hub could support people between jobs through volunteering, projects, networking and developing new skills.

sessions.title: Love as a Commons
sessions.description: What happens when we stop treating love as something we own, and start thinking of it as something we can share and care for together? An open conversation for people with experience of open relationships or polyamory, and those simply curious to learn more. Bring your stories, questions and experiences as we explore intimacy, trust, boundaries and care - and maybe what it means to open-source love.

sessions.title: Finding Ground When the World Feels Too Much
sessions.description: Explore simple somatic practices to help you find your ground when life feels overwhelming. Discover how your body can become a resource for navigating stress, building resilience, and staying connected to yourself and others.

sessions.title: Valley of the Commons: Lessons from a 4-Week Pop-Up Community
sessions.description: Leen, Xavier and Inge share their experience at the Valley of the Commons at Commons Hub Austria: a four-week immersive pop-up community in the valley where regenerative living, local economics and deep human connection are practiced, not just preached.

sessions.title: Leviathan Movie Night
sessions.description: Get comfy for a group screening of Leviathan, followed by a discussion over some chips. The film raises questions about power, institutions and community - all central to thinking about the commons.
